===== easyeda workflow --help (exit=0) =====
Compatibility interface for the former per-project PCB workflow.

Historical stages:
  imported → placement_ready → placement_confirmed → outline_confirmed
           → pre_route_passed → routing_authorized

No stage is an execution permission. Route, placement, outline and raw typed
actions run from live project data regardless of these records. Mutations no
longer cascade through confirmations, and legacy --force options are no-ops.
Use connectivity, geometric checks, DRC and save/reload/readback as evidence.

State lives at ~/.easyeda-agent/workflow/<project>.json (EASYEDA_WORKFLOW_DIR
to override). Existing scripts may inspect or append it; `status` and
`advance` describe only the deprecated checklist and do not control
other commands.

Usage:
  easyeda workflow [flags]
  easyeda workflow [command]

Available Commands:
  advance     Advance the deprecated checklist and print its historical next step
  confirm     Record a historical layout/outline checklist entry (no execution permission)
  init        Initialize (or restart) the deprecated project checklist
  pages       逐页记账的工程归属表(--reap 用活体页表核销,--prune 删掉已证明外来的残留)
  reset       Clear deprecated checklist entries (or --all)
  status      Show deprecated checklist state; --reconcile compares it with the live document

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for workflow
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID (else use --project)

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda workflow [command] --help" for more information about a command.
